response: Yes, topical ropivacaine has been shown to reduce post-tonsillectomy morbidity in pediatric patients. Studies have demonstrated that the application of topical ropivacaine to the tonsillar bed after tonsillectomy can decrease postoperative pain, reduce the need for analgesics, and minimize bleeding complications, ultimately leading to a faster recovery and reduced morbidity in pediatric patients undergoing tonsillectomy.
